request.query: Suggest BIS recognised labs to test two-wheeler helmets

response.text:
For testing two-wheeler helmets under IS 4151:2015, the following BIS recognised laboratories are listed with their locations and charges[1]:

*   PRESTO LABORATORIES PRIVATE LIMITED, Haryana; charges Rs. 14,000 excluding taxes[1].
*   Samridhi Test House Pvt. Ltd., Delhi; charges Rs. 14,000 excluding taxes[1].
*   Bharat Test House Pvt. Ltd., Sonipat, Haryana; charges Rs. 14,200 excluding taxes[1].
*   Delta Testing and Research Laboratories Private Limited, Delhi; charges Rs. 55,000 excluding taxes[1].
*   PIONEER TESTING LABORATORY PRIVATE LIMITED, Delhi; charges Rs. 37,350 excluding taxes[1].
*   Testtex India Laboratories Private Limited, Noida, Uttar Pradesh; charges Rs. 20,000 or Rs. 31,500 excluding taxes depending on the specific entry[1].

You can verify current scopes and availability on the LIMS portal at lims.bis.gov.in[2][3].

sources.label: BIS GUIDANCE PAGE
sources.title: BIS laboratories, recognised labs and testing
sources.heading: Laboratory FAQ
sources.chunk_text:
4. What is the fee structure for getting my Labs Recognized by BIS?
The Fee Structure for Laboratory Recognition is given in the Laboratory Recognition Scheme and subsequent amendments.
5. Where can I find the test facilities available in any particular BIS Lab /BIS Recognized Lab?
The details of the test facilities available in the BIS labs, BIS recognised labs and BIS empanelled labs are available at LIMS portal (lims.bis.gov.in). For Indian Standard wise information of the laboratory, select the ‘Search by IS number’ tile on the LIMS portal.
6. Do BIS labs test products for any customer?
No, BIS Laboratories only tests the product for the Conformity Assessment Schemes of BIS and does not carry out commercial testing. For commercial testing, the services of BIS recognised/empanelled labs as well as other outside laboratories can be utilised.
7. I am a manufacturer and want to get my product tested in BIS lab/BIS recognised lab/BIS empanelled lab for applying for license/recognition under option-2 (simplified procedure), how should I submit my product sample for testing? What are the testing charges for such samples?

sources.heading: Laboratory services overview
sources.chunk_text:
To protect consumer’s interest,BIS operates various conformity assessment schemes.Under these schemes, BIS grants licenses/registrations to such manufacturers who are capable of producing goods conforming to relevant Indian Standards, on continuous basis. To support these scheme,which requires testing of products on regular basis for checking conformity to the relevant Indian Standards, BIS has established a network of eight laboratories.
Testing facility & Testing Charges

- BIS Recognized LAB-Wise Test Facilities

- The full details of laboratories,scope of testing and testing charges are available at lims.bis.gov.in
